title: HDM Activity Primitive Contracts — Physical Primitive Shard
$comment: Physical-representation shape of one DEV/CATALOG/activity-primitive-contracts/primitives/<primitive_id>.json shard: exactly one primitive's `contract` and `validation_matrix`, held together as one semantic unit, matching the identity-bound pair the logical schema requires (contracts[primitive_id] + primitive_validation_matrix[primitive_id]). Reuses the `contract` and `primitiveValidationMatrix` $defs from the canonical logical schema via $ref. DEV/TOOLS/activity_primitive_contracts.py separately enforces that `contract.primitive_id`, the wrapper's own `primitive_id` and the shard's file name all agree.
